runs.failure: Swept step produced an inverted or degenerate element; the input state was restored

method: Public build_poke_scene(swept_contact=True, friction=0) and Example._Forward; explicit fully kinematic probe endpoints; 1050 steps at dt=1/900 s. Optional swept VF/EE contact with coupled certified normal response and invalid-element rejection; original NH material equations.
scope: 35-frame forward validation on the prepared recording geometry, which differs from the original generated slab and 24-section TetGen probe. Not a fitted checkpoint. The swept contact extension changes contact, probe prescription and friction relative to the original training mode.
measurement: 45 barycentric samples per probe triangle queried against oriented tetrahedral boundary and embedded display surface; die boundary vertices queried against probe. These sampled distances do not prove global nonintersection. Inversions, deformation and tracking are measured each recorded frame; iterations, status and contact pairs every substep.
timing_scope: Includes per-step host synchronization, signed-distance diagnostics and output writes; not a throughput benchmark. Concurrent user GPU work may affect timing.
source_change_scope: This report exercises forward only; adjoint.py is not called.

acceptance.rejection: An inverted clamp-adjacent tetrahedron; solver status64. Contact status0; failed step restored incoming positions and velocities.
acceptance.scope: Saved initial state, 15 complete recorded-frame states and one partial state at step 477. Samples do not prove global separation. Every accepted physical step also passed the numerical swept-contact certificate and endpoint determinant check.

failed_step_convergence_study.source: same production solver; only tolerance and Anderson window varied on the saved failed step
failed_step_convergence_study.result: All replayed variants reject the same inverted element; tighter convergence does not resolve the collapse.

diagnostic_kinematic_probe_without_elast.scope: Isolated diagnostic solver copy allowed unattached prescribed probe vertices; only the die had elastic tetrahedra. Original material formulas, trajectories and contact settings retained.
diagnostic_kinematic_probe_without_elast.failure: Swept step produced an inverted or degenerate element; the input state was restored
diagnostic_kinematic_probe_without_elast.interpretation: Removing elastic probe tetrahedra changes the NH projection mean lambda/mu ratio from approximately9 to4 but does not resolve clamp-side element inversion.
